scope: Native UO source preflight; not a new D2R or native timed-execution acceptance certificate

findings.observed: Hourly path subtracts 10 loyalty from world-present Controlled and Commandable creatures, queuing Release at zero. Its exemption checks mercenary KeepEquipment but not PersistentMinion.
findings.risk: An untimed active Revive can still be released by the native pet system.

findings.observed: Low MinTameSkill, summoned status or GM exempts control chance. Otherwise native taming/lore/loyalty arithmetic applies; PersistentMinion is not checked. Actual originals retain their concrete native type, are Controlled and not Summoned.
findings.risk: Revived high-taming native creatures can reject owner commands or lose loyalty.

findings.observed: Default getter returns true; Tamable=false is not a loyalty exemption.
findings.risk: Activation clearing Tamable does not resolve these paths.

next: Bind existing class-minion identity to native loyalty/control exclusions, with real native path and ordinary-pet negative controls. Do not add a source lifetime timer or enable learned Revive before remaining source stats/AI/input composition.

existingClassPattern.observed: SkeletonGuardian overrides Commandable to false; NecromancerMinion inherits that behavior. Actual revived NPC types retain their original concrete type, so they need the equivalent native identity-based behavior rather than a replacement subclass.
